title.zh: ⚡️慢雾发布DarkSword木马分析报告：公开代码被武器化，iOS加密钱包面临威胁
title.en: ⚡️慢雾发布DarkSword木马分析报告：公开代码被武器化，iOS加密钱包面临威胁

current_state.zh: SlowMist published an in-depth report on the DarkSword trojan, an automated iOS attack framework built from publicly released exploit code that targets crypto wallet data and drains funds on specific iOS versions, urging users to update, treat exposed seed phrases as compromised, and revoke token approvals.
